record_history.description: Listado confirmado por Carlos; vínculo público entre CI, instancia y modelo. No es una auditoría de cambios del equipo.
record_history.description_en: List confirmed by Carlos; public link between CI, instance and model. This is not an equipment change audit.

record_history.description: Ficha visual unificada añadida; identidades y modelos conservados. El histórico patrimonial permanece en Yokup.
record_history.description_en: Unified visual record added; identities and models retained. Lifecycle history remains in Yokup.

record_history.description: Carlos solicita un iPad horizontal virtual en lugar del cartel. Alta de identidad y mapeo; instalación física pendiente.
record_history.description_en: Carlos requests a virtual landscape iPad replacing the sign. Identity and mapping registered; physical installation pending.

record_history.description: Alta en Yokup de las tres cestas trenzadas fotografiadas por Carlos el 17-10-2026 (vasos BE GREEN, snacks y café 1971), con modelos 53, 54 y 55 del Taller 3D.
record_history.description_en: Yokup registration of the three woven baskets Carlos photographed on 17-10-2026 (BE GREEN cups, snacks and 1971 coffee), with 3D-workshop models 53, 54 and 55.

record_history.description: Alta en Yokup de 33 objetos separados del escaneo 3D de SuperSplat (8f6bd2f6) por el Arquitecto: 3 estanterías, 7 sillas, 1 mesa, 14 cestas y 8 lámparas, sin modelo 3D ni foto; los 34 objetos genéricos no se dieron de alta (decisión de Carlos).
record_history.description_en: Yokup registration of 33 objects separated from the SuperSplat 3D scan (8f6bd2f6) by the Architect: 3 shelves, 7 chairs, 1 table, 14 baskets and 8 lamps, with no 3D model or photo; the 34 generic objects were not registered (Carlos’s decision).
